summary:
Turn 41 closed the deployed-variant question from the configuration and recorded it in the map.

What was established. The shipped aws.conf designates a leader alias (leader: 0.0.0.1, the first listed replica) and sets leaderless: false, with protocol SwiftPaxos that run-time flags override per run. Because the master's designation calls Replica.BeTheLeader on the marked replica (at startup and again when it promotes on a dead leader), running that configuration under the epaxos protocol leaves exactly one replica with IsLeader = true and the others false, so makeBallot's raising loop is active on that replica when it recovers instances. This complements the master call-site relationship recorded last turn: the deployment is not uniformly IsLeader false, which is a variant the confirmed findings must be read against.

Product and map update (accepted base version 8, one clarified object). The configuration is registered as a new source and Behavior B14-ballot-monotonicity gained a branch recording the designation and its consequence for the deployment variant; the ballot arithmetic, the master call sites already recorded and the protocol-level ownership statement are unchanged, and the map_changes entry carries the source and a preserves explanation.

Left open rather than folded in. Whether IsLeader = true changes the confirmed recovery finding: the reasoning is that it only raises the new ballot further, so the recovering replica's self entry still announces the new ballot as its VBallot and remote values at older vbals are still skipped, but no check has been run with the flag set and the C1 claim's confirmed scope records IsLeader false — so that remains an explicit remaining question rather than an extension of a confirmed claim. Also still visible: whether a promoted replica's higher ballots affect accept-round completion or the crash finding, the scope-issue bookkeeping on the superseded C1 artifact, and the unread helper surfaces (replica/sender.go, replica/mset.go, hook/). No requirement, premise or earlier observation was weakened.
